reproducibility_gaps: No repository license defines reuse terms.
No formal dependency manifest or installation command is provided despite README version declarations.
TensorFlow/NumPy seeds are not controlled; the compression case reports no seed and the ironing case sets only Python's random seed.
Coord.mat schemas, provenance and sample counts are not documented beyond the keys consumed by source.
No pretrained weights, reference output files, tests or quantitative acceptance thresholds are bundled.
The self-cited paper is not an Atlas relationship for CR000175.
Prepared MAT inputs were not loaded and training was not executed within the static boundary.
notes: R3 is supported by pinned source, documented versioned environment, prepared case inputs, explicit entrypoints and detailed physics/training configurations. R4 is blocked by absent reference artifacts and deterministic validation controls.
